relation: Exact finite-poset cover-minor unavoidability: one natural threshold d chosen before all finite posets, and every poset whose dimension is not at most d (GTBase.posets, realizers may be empty) has H as a minor of its cover graph, host before pattern (upstream minor). d = 0, empty carriers and empty graphs allowed; no planarity or width condition on H; not induced minors, subdivisions or the exact-order tournament unavoidability of Digraph.conjectures.unvd.unavoidable, which is the separate tournament-exact-order class with its own Digraph canonical.
summary: C21 migrates exactly Minor.conjectures.X228.x228_unavoidable onto Minor.foundations.poset_unavoidability.poset_unavoidable with the identical body: one threshold d before all finite posets, the negated GTBase dimension bound as the only guard, and an upstream minor of the cover graph with host before pattern. d = 0 and empty posets stay allowed; GTBase.posets and upstream minor are unchanged.

The helper and the whole BLOCKED row unavoidable_minor_kelly_construction_statement are frozen verbatim with an unconditional helper iff and a complete row iff. The row keeps its Kelly-construction placeholder implication to planarity and treewidth at most three; no converse, construction or status change. There is no earlier frozen history; all eleven grounding theorem types and the sibling queue-number row are unchanged.

The public-only client covers the empty graph, raising thresholds, minor downward closure and the unit poset: it has dimension at most 0, so the guard never tests it, and its cover graph has no K2 minor. This shows the guard has teeth; it is not a claim that K2 is avoidable.

C22 adds the distinct tournament-exact-order class. Digraph.conjectures.unvd.unavoidable, unvd.unvd and X221.x221_linearly_unavoidable now unfold to Digraph.foundations.tournament_unavoidability (tournament_unavoidable, unavoidability_number, linearly_unavoidable): bundled Digraph.core tournaments of exactly N vertices, injective upstream is_dhom maps through to_GT (one-way, not induced), every smaller M excluded, one natural C before all digraphs. Arbitrary finite D (loops and digons allowed, then no value), exact N and the empty value 0 are kept; no existence, positivity or acyclicity guard is added, and the class is never identified with the Minor poset contract.

The supports heroes.is_tournament and unvd.contains_subdigraph are frozen as unchanged chain objects; they stay live, unmigrated and in their own inventory groups. The frozen unavoidable uses both frozen supports, the frozen unvd uses the frozen unavoidable and the frozen linear class uses the frozen unvd. Live proofs reach the unbundled reading through unvd.unavoidableP, a conjecture-local wrapper of the public same-carrier factory bridge tournament_unavoidable_unbundledE.

Five whole Props have complete iff certificates: X17 Sumner (oriented tree, 1 < n, order n, value 2n - 2), unvd.conj_9 (acyclicb, 1 < #|D|, uniform C under vertex deletion), unvd.prob_6 (nonempty, rational mad bound, uniform a, d, b), the X221 k-extension row, and the non-corpus alias reals_growth.prob6_unvd_statement, whose frozen copy is the frozen prob_6. All four corpus statement legs stay done and gc:e106 stays a candidate. prob6_nat_bound_real_envelope and its existing axioms are unchanged and outside these closures.

Directed scope: 3 sources, 2 supports and 5 whole Props make 10 new frozen objects (12 with the two C21 objects); there is no earlier directed frozen history. The 14 reverse files keep all 221 theorem headers. Five direct proof consumers use unavoidableP and the other three compile unchanged. Public client: digraph-theory/theories/examples/tournament_unavoidability.v.

known_stale_snapshots.digraph-theory/theories/migration/degree: B16 snapshot kept byte-exact. Its contains_subdigraph support is frozen by C22 for its own chains but remains an unchanged live definition, not a migrated alias; this B16 body reaches no new C22 canonical. No additional Original is required and no B16 proof/body is redirected.
